rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of VAJRAPANI, the Mahayana bodhisattva protector and guide of Gautama Buddha [vajrapani-c01], in his documented HUMAN FORM holding a VAJRA IN THE RIGHT HAND [vajrapani-c05], with a wrathful protective expression [vajrapani-c06].
ANATOMY: ONE HUMAN HEAD with exactly TWO normal eyes, two arms, two legs, no third eye, extra head, animal face or demon traits. Fully opaque high-neck heavy maroon-and-saffron Buddhist ceremonial robes with long sleeves cover torso, shoulders, arms, legs and groin; only face and hands exposed. His RIGHT hand (on viewer's LEFT in frontal view) grips ONE unmistakable antique-gold DOUBLE-ENDED VAJRA/dorje ritual thunderbolt, compact central grip between two matching pronged ends. His LEFT hand is empty and clearly attached to his other arm. No crown, flame halo or undocumented weapon. Detailed clothing and vajra materials are editorial, right-hand attribute is sourced c05.
POWER: no documented physical lightning or elemental power; the vajra is a held symbolic attribute, not an energy generator. Menace through human form, wrathful brows, protective action and lighting alone; no electricity, sparks, body glow or aura. Symbol of Buddha's power [vajrapani-c03] does not authorize invented magic.
MOMENT: Vajrapani steps decisively toward the low viewer, his RIGHT hand driving the real solid vajra forward close to the camera, LEFT hand spread protectively beside his chest. Fierce furrowed brows and tightly set mouth confront viewer, no fangs. His robe pulls backward with the physical stride; one foot raises ordinary dust.
COMPOSITION: extreme low close frontal three-quarter view, face and shoulders dominant, right-hand vajra large in near-left foreground and left empty hand on the opposite side; whole head and both vajra ends inside square. No giant anatomical size claim.
STYLE/LIGHT: original premium painterly texture, rich walnut/maroon shadows, antique gold highlights, one dramatic ordinary warm side light, dust from actual foot contact; no generic glowing aura or flames. SETTING: plain unnamed dark ground, editorial minimal backdrop, no invented named monastery or event. MOOD: wrathful protective Buddhist authority, awe-inspiring and respectful, not evil, cute, monstrous or ordinary monk. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, scripts, pseudo-writing, logos, borders, frames, watermark, signature, nudity, gore, victims, extra heads/eyes/arms, fangs, weapons, floating runes, neon outline, energy ribbons or borrowed film/game/anime/comic design.
